name: B10-0432/2025 (PPE) – Humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the September 2025 massacre in Cabaret, where gangs killed at least 50 people, and calls for action on Haiti's crisis. It asks the European Union to tie cooperation with Haiti to real progress against gang violence and to send more humanitarian aid. It also urges countries to stop weapons reaching the gangs, strengthen border controls, and support rebuilding Haiti's police, army and courts. The text is the Parliament's position and request; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the EU and other countries to act.
- **Who it affects:** Haiti's people, its authorities, and EU member states.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council, Commission and others for follow-up.
